review.notes: Full review of the folder. SchneiderTeitelbaum2001 Appendix Theorem (c) verified at lines 1230-1234. 39 cross-roadmap section ids in 12 roadmaps resolved on main or at open heads and read against their use; downstream ids exist. Library names opened at the pins (Tau Ceti cotangent module, Mathlib GroupLike, IsCocomm, gaussNorm, toNormalization). Automatic checks all passed; depcheck 171 roadmaps, 1997 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean: two sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes neither theorem; no change outside the folder and the family index; description agrees with the head.
